title: Austin Leaders Go Private on Key City Roles
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   Austin leaders held a special meeting conducted entirely in a closed-door executive session via video conference.
*   Discussions in the private session focused on personnel matters concerning the City Clerk and City Manager, as well as legal matters for specific agenda items (2-5).
*   No public decisions were made, and there was no public discussion on policy topics, including COVID-19 related matters, which were on the agenda but not addressed publicly.
